neighbours.label: a split C/K piece that starts a word stem after a prefix or hyphen (Anti-Capitalism, Neo|c|lassical, князь)
fire: The pamphlet attacked the Anti-Communist league in harsh terms.
She joined an anti-Colonial movement as a student.
The town hall is a fine example of Neoclassical design.
His essays on Post-Capitalism drew a large audience.
The museum holds paintings from the neoclassical period.
The pro-Catholic faction won the vote in the assembly.
Many voters supported the anti-Corruption platform.
He wrote a long history of the Counter-Culture of the sixties.

She joined an anti-war movement as a student.
The town hall is a fine example of Neo-Gothic design.

The museum holds paintings from the baroque period.

notes: Card: ' к' (князь) x8, ' C'/'-C' (Czar, Anti-Capitalism, Cagoulard), 'oc' in Neoclassical. Probe: Anti-Capitalism '-C' 0.72, Neoclassical 'oc' 0.31, whole-token Czar 0.02. Near misses: same prefixed words whose stem starts with another letter.
